entities.summary: Héctor Eduardo Reglero Montaner, better known as Ricardo Montaner, is an Argentine-born singer. Since starting his career in the late 1970s, he has released more than 24 albums, and many successful singles. He has sold an estimated 10 million records worldwide, making him one of the best-selling Latin music artists.
